name: Pi Drain Follow-up
description: Drains follow-up messages queued from outside the graph (--follow-up, or `graph-agent follow-up <session> <text>`). The agent would otherwise stop here; a queued follow-up sends the outer loop back for another turn.

properties.label: Has follow-up
properties.description: Process variable set when a follow-up message was queued; route a gateway on this to decide whether to loop back for another turn.
